description: [Launch directories] Use this after report_result or to resume a session; requires the Submit Kit key. Returns product_type, cap, sites, progress_page and counts: issued (total handed out), unreported, submitted, listed_reported, rejected, failed and skipped. Outstanding sites have status 'issued' in sites. Remaining allowance is cap minus issued, not a returned field or a guarantee of matching directories. Not for AgentoolRank listing review status — that is get_submission_status.
